title: Silkwood
description: Silkwood – Smooth pastel-style woods & leaves & saplings
body:
**Silkwood gives Minecraft a soft, pastel makeover! 🌿**

All wood types, leaves, and saplings have been redesigned with smooth pastel tones, creating a cozy and calm atmosphere in your world.

![Before leaves & woods & saplings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4a1d6089ad03d723173b4ff75df0c99581460f1.png)

![After leaves & woods & saplings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f46889c43fd96bba4ab28bb70b60f68edb13bf4.png)

**✨ Features:**

_-Pastel retextures for every wood type_ 

_-Smooth, soft-colored leaves and saplings_ 

_-A gentle, aesthetic style that makes your builds feel warm and relaxing_ 


♥️
